frontend.src/routes/index.tsx: Public school website. LandingPage fetches public landing content, supplies fallback branding, shows programs and contact information, and submits a visitor inquiry. parseImages decodes the JSON string used for hero image URLs. HeroCarousel rotates images; Reveal and the reveal hook handle entrance visibility. whatsAppLink converts a phone string into a contact link. This route is outside the signed-in layout.
frontend.src/routes/auth.tsx: Login screen with public branding, identifier/password drafts, busy feedback, password visibility, and navigation after login. AuthProvider performs persistence. A must-change-password response directs the user into the password-change flow. Login success is authentication; later API actions still require authorization.
frontend.src/routes/forgot-password.tsx: Public recovery form. Its mutation sends an email to the public forgot-password endpoint and displays the same sent state rather than revealing whether an account exists. The backend controls token generation and mail delivery.
frontend.src/routes/reset-password.tsx: Reads a token from route search parameters, collects and confirms a new password, and calls the public reset endpoint. Local validation and busy state support the form; the backend validates the token and expiry and clears it after use.
frontend.src/routes/change-password.tsx: Signed-in password replacement flow for temporary credentials. It checks the password draft and confirmation, calls auth.changePassword, clears the stored mustChangePassword flag through AuthProvider, and navigates onward. Clearing the local flag prevents the layout from redirecting back after success.
frontend.src/routes/__root.tsx: Application root. Declares document metadata, CSS, favicon, external font links, 404 handling, and route error recovery. RootShell emits the HTML document with HeadContent and Scripts. RootComponent installs QueryClientProvider and AuthProvider around Outlet and the global toast renderer. Keep the provider and outlet structure when changing the shell.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/route.tsx: Pathless signed-in layout with SSR disabled. Waits for stored authentication to load, redirects missing users, enforces the browser password-change flow, and restricts parent-only navigation. Renders AppSidebar, mobile navigation controls, theme switch, user menu, page title, and child Outlet. These browser redirects are not server authorization checks.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/academic-years: Academic year and term administration. Loads both collections, opens separate year and term forms, and creates/deletes records. Current flags and date ranges link the academic setup to attendance, billing, and report periods. Mutation callbacks invalidate the related collections; backend code determines whether other current flags are cleared.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/accounts.tsx: Financial overview split into Summary, Expenses, and Income components. Summary combines confirmed payments, canteen sales, admission registration income, and expenses. Expenses filters by category, method, date, and text, supports create/correction/deletion, and exports CSV. Income normalizes different sources into comparable rows and adds pupil/class/term/year filters. Role-based correction UI must be compared with backend accounts:reverse permission.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/admissions.tsx: Application list, status changes, deletion, enrollment, and registration-fee entry. ApplicationForm collects applicant and parent contact data. RegFeeDialog updates payment fields on an existing application. Enrollment is a business action that creates a pupil and links it back; contact text alone does not provision a parent login. Read the backend update mapper before submitting a fee-only partial update, since it assigns other fields from the request too.
Notice list with audience labels and create/edit drafts. Reads announcements and refreshes the ann cache after writes. Management controls use ADMIN_ROLES in this file, while backend posting uses a permission; custom roles can expose a difference between button visibility and authorization.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/attendance.tsx: Daily marking and monthly register in separate tabs. useClassOptions chooses available classes. DailyAttendanceTab merges saved records with a local pupil-status draft and submits bulk upserts. Local date helpers build date boundaries without UTC day shifts. AttendanceRegisterTab pivots records by pupil and day, counts statuses, and opens AttendanceRegisterPrint for printing.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/audit.tsx: Read-only audit log browser. Keeps zero-based page and entity filter state, calls the paginated audit API, and gives actions coloured labels. Logs reflect explicit audit calls, not an automatic history of every SQL change.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/backup.tsx: Backup control screen. Supports full ZIP, SQL, JSON, and CSV downloads, lists scheduled archives, and has a restore card guarded by backup:restore. RestoreCard requires the typed RESTORE phrase before submitting a ZIP. Blob download handling differs from JSON API calls. The current backend restore affects both database and upload files.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/calendar.tsx: Calendar event list and creation form for title, description, timestamps, location, and audience. Creates/deletes through the events API and invalidates its cache. Management UI uses administrator role membership; server permission remains authoritative.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/canteen.tsx: Tabbed canteen module. Summary calculates sales and subscription metrics. Menu and MenuForm manage priced items; Plans manages meal packages; Subs manages pupil plan subscriptions and date durations; Sales records quantities and payment method. computeEndDate derives subscription end dates from a duration and optional term end. These sales are not the same data type as invoice payments.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/classes.tsx: Class records with teacher and capacity information, editing, roster inspection, and register printing. RosterDialog loads current and eligible pupils and can move pupils through the pupil update API. A class change may also update enrollment history and trigger recurring billing in PupilService. ClassRegisterPrint composes a paper view.
Composes and lists communication records with channel, audience, optional class, subject, and recipient label. A saved record comes from CommunicationController; that controller does not implement provider delivery. The UI is a record of messages, not evidence of a real SMS/email transmission.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx: School welcome page using shared school settings and announcements. greeting selects time-of-day copy. parseLinks and parseImages decode JSON-backed settings. DashboardEditor and LandingEditor let the super administrator change dashboard hero/links and public landing content through separate settings endpoints. This screen is not simply a rendering of DashboardService statistics.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/discipline.tsx: Discipline and reward records for pupils, with a record form and deletion. Loads pupils as supporting data and gates management controls with discipline:manage. Backend scope checks determine which pupil records a teacher may access.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/documents.tsx: School document catalog with title, category, description, and uploaded URL. Uses FileUploadField for bytes and a separate create call for metadata. Deleting metadata does not by itself delete the file stored on disk; public upload access is configured independently.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/exams.tsx: Assessment definitions with term filter and create/edit dialogs. ExamFormFields edits name, term, type, date, maximum score, and weight. Current backend update persists only some of those fields. The Java Exam entity has a computed termId JSON getter as well as the nested term relationship, supporting this page's flat termId read. Compare both contracts before diagnosing an editor issue as a cache issue.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/fees.tsx: Finance workspace with invoice, payment, pending-claim, and fee-item sections. Includes invoice printing, payment correction/reversal, claim confirmation/rejection, fee-item configuration, CSV exports, late-fee application, and class billing. BillClassDialog prepares bulk invoice requests from selected pupils and fee items. Billed amounts and confirmed collections are separate measures.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/guardians.tsx: Guardian directory, editable contact details, parent account provisioning, and pupil linking. ParentAccountDialog sends a temporary password; LinkPupilDialog selects an existing pupil. Creating a contact record, creating a login, and linking a child are separate operations with separate consequences.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/guardians_.$gu: Dynamic guardian detail view. Reads guardianId from the route, loads linked pupils, and assembles related invoice information and profile statistics. Supporting finance requests can require permissions beyond guardian management, so missing data may reflect denied supporting requests.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/health.tsx: Clinic record management for pupils. HealthForm collects encounter details; mutations create/update/delete records and refresh the health list. Pupil selection and class scope govern record association and access. This is school clinic administration, not an automated medical decision system.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/homework.tsx: Homework listing and editor with class/subject selection, due date, description, and attachments. Chooses available classes according to teacher status. Creation and editing share form fields; attachment upload and homework save are distinct requests. Backend class scope applies to the homework's class.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/inquiries.tsx: Staff inbox for website inquiries. Loads the newest inquiries, marks records read, and deletes records according to inquiry permissions. The original visitor submission occurs in the public landing route and PublicController.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/inventory.tsx: Inventory item table with local filtering, low-stock presentation, item create/edit/delete, and a stock transaction form. TxnForm submits item ID, direction, quantity, reason, and reference. Read the server ADJUST branch: it adds a delta rather than replacing the count.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/leave.tsx: Staff leave list and request form, with approval, rejection, and deletion. Staff options come from staff.all; status changes call action endpoints. This module's leave:manage permission is distinct from the staff directory's view permission.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/library.tsx: Book catalog and loan workflow. Books/BookForm edit catalog data; Loans/LoanForm choose a borrower and due date and support returns. Server code changes available copies. Repeated returns are not currently guarded server-side, so the UI should not be treated as the sole integrity boundary.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/marks.tsx: Marks-entry grid. Selected term filters exams; class controls pupils; subject controls displayed marks. Local scores/comments override saved values for editing. Saving loops sequentially through pupils with nonblank scores and upserts one mark per HTTP call. Partial save is possible; empty score and zero score are different.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/meetings.tsx: PTC scheduling with parent, teacher, and administrative views. SessionsTab manages event sessions; AdminMeetingsTab schedules staff/guardian/pupil slots; MeetingCard displays or edits meeting notes/status. Parent and teacher lists use different current-user endpoints. Backend meeting update currently requires ptc:manage, so a teacher note control may still receive 403 without that grant.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/payroll.tsx: Payroll periods and payslips. PeriodForm creates date ranges; SlipForm creates staff pay calculations; EditSlipForm corrects components; PayslipPrint renders a paper record. Approve and mark-paid are separate actions. Mark-paid generates an accounts expense, whereas slip creation alone does not.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/portal.tsx: Parent workspace for linked children, invoices, payments, attendance, homework, and performance. PerformanceTab reads child report-card DTOs calculated by ParentPortalService. ParentReportCardView and ParentReportCardPrint render the term pivot and remarks. Online payments reuse PayOnlineDialog with guardian-specific initiate/status callbacks.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/procurement.ts: Supplier directory and purchase order workflow. SupplierForm handles contact data; POs maintains line drafts, calculates displayed totals, submits orders, changes allowed statuses, and receives orders. Receive calls the business action that credits inventory and records movement, rather than only editing a status label.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/promotions.tsx: Bulk progression screen selecting source class, eligible next-level destination, year/date, and pupil IDs. togglePupil/toggleAll manage a Set-like selection. The server revalidates active pupils, next configured grade, capacity, and enrollment history; frontend filtering is not sufficient validation.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/pupils.tsx: Large pupil directory with class/search filters, pagination, CSV export, create/edit forms, guardian links, optional transport assignment, and bulk CSV import. PupilForm and PupilEditForm collect profile details. BulkImport parses/validates rows and creates pupils individually. A multi-step pupil/guardian/transport workflow spans requests, so follow-up failures do not roll back an already created pupil.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/pupils_.$pupil: Dynamic pupil profile. Reads pupilId and combines pupil details, guardians, invoices, attendance, health, and discipline queries. Displays profile fields and statistics, and offers online invoice payment with staff fee endpoints. Supporting requests can have different permissions and cache keys.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/report-cards.t: Assessment analysis and printing. Helpers group marks, calculate pupil averages, rank pupils, pivot assessment types, compute subject statistics and grade distributions, and export CSV. ReportCardTab creates term cards and remarks; ClassAnalysisTab and SchoolAnalysisTab analyse exam-level performance. Missing assessment handling, decimal grading, current class filtering, and separate parent calculations require careful comparison.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/reports.tsx: Read-only school summary metrics from reports.get and the backend reports/summary endpoint. Uses loading/empty presentation and statistic cards. This is a separate aggregation path from the editable dashboard welcome page.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/settings.tsx: School profile settings editor. Loads the school object, synchronizes a local form, uploads image/signature references, and submits fields to the general settings endpoint. Dashboard and landing content have separate super-admin endpoints used by dashboard.tsx. Updating the school cache may not invalidate every independently named print/public query.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/staff.tsx: Staff directory with profile forms, teacher flag, employment/category/contract details, financial fields, images/signatures, and login provisioning. StaffAccountDialog sends an optional new temporary password to the account action. StaffService synchronizes linked account data and teacher role membership.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/staff_.$staffI: Dynamic staff profile showing personal/employment data, assigned classes, payslips, and leave. Payslip and leave requests require their own backend permissions even when staff details are visible. The route does not make those supporting endpoints public.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/subjects.tsx: Small reference CRUD page suitable for the first lesson. Loads subjects, keeps a create draft, creates/deletes records, refreshes the subjects cache, and hides management controls without subjects:manage. Use it to teach state versus saved data and query versus mutation.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/timetable.tsx: Class timetable in weekday columns. Chooses all or current teacher classes, loads subject/teacher options, filters slots by class, and creates/deletes slots. Days use numeric values 1 through 5 in the visible grid. Server scope checks and timetable:manage protect writes; no complete scheduling-conflict algorithm is implied.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/transport.tsx: Tabbed vehicles, routes, priced pickup points, and pupil assignments. RoutePointsDialog edits fees per point. Assignments creates a pupil-route-point association, which triggers backend transport billing. Removing an assignment does not automatically reverse an already issued invoice.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/uniform.tsx: Uniform catalog and invoice-based sales. Summary totals created invoice amounts by local day/month. Catalog edits UNIFORM fee items; Sales multiplies price by quantity and creates a pupil invoice. No inventory quantity is decremented by this module, and invoiced totals do not mean cash has been collected.
frontend.src/routes/_authenticated/users.tsx: User and dynamic role administration. UsersTab creates users, changes roles, resets temporary passwords, and deletes accounts. RolesTab groups permissions by module, supports individual and page-wide toggles, and edits role grants. Page toggles grant all permissions in that module, not just view. Frontend stored permissions can remain stale until the user logs in again.
frontend.src/components/AppSidebar.tsx: Central navigation registry grouped by school function. canSee applies parent-only navigation, optional role membership, and permission visibility. Active paths are highlighted. Desktop and mobile layouts share content. Hiding a link does not prevent manually requesting the URL or API.
frontend.src/components/AttachmentPreview.tsx: Chooses image, embedded PDF, or file-link presentation using the URL extension. It does not validate actual bytes or permission. Links open a new tab; PDFs use an iframe.
frontend.src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty-data presentation accepting an optional icon, message, description, and action. It contains no data loading. The caller must distinguish empty data from a failed query.
frontend.src/components/ExportActions.tsx: Shared CSV download and browser print buttons. onDownload is supplied by the caller; the print action uses window.print. CSV is spreadsheet-compatible text, not a native Excel workbook.
frontend.src/components/FileUploadField.tsx: Attachment chooser with busy state and an input ref. Uploads through api.uploads.upload, passes the returned URL to the parent, resets the input, and displays AttachmentPreview. Clearing the field only clears the parent's URL.
frontend.src/components/ImageUploadField.tsx: Image URL field plus device picker and thumbnail. Uses the same multipart upload endpoint as general attachments. The parent remains responsible for saving the URL with its record.
frontend.src/components/PageHeader.tsx: Shared title, optional description, and actions row with responsive layout and no-print styling. Contains presentation only; actions are React nodes supplied by each page.
frontend.src/components/PaginationBar.tsx: Displays a zero-based page as a human one-based page, computes visible row bounds, and calls onPageChange. Does not fetch or slice records itself. It can work with client-sliced data or server pages if the supplied totals are correct.
frontend.src/components/PayOnlineDialog.tsx: Reusable mobile-money flow with injected initiate/checkStatus callbacks so parent and staff endpoints share UI. Captures amount/network/phone, tracks a gateway reference, polls every three seconds for up to four minutes, reports failure or success, and invokes onSuccess. A polling timeout is not a provider failure.
frontend.src/components/PrintableDoc.tsx: Shared school-settings print query, React portal print overlay, and document header. Clicking the outer overlay closes it; inner clicks stop propagation. The portal moves printable markup under document.body, and CSS isolates the print area.
frontend.src/components/ProfileHeader.tsx: Shared person profile header with photo or initials, name/subtitle, badges, and metadata. Exports Section and Field for consistent detail layouts. profileInitials uses the first two nonblank name parts.
frontend.src/components/ReceiptPrint.tsx: Receipt layout using PrintOverlay, DocHeader, school settings, payment data, and invoice totals. Outstanding balance is invoice total minus paid. The receipt uses the supplied snapshot; it does not itself re-fetch or confirm a payment.
frontend.src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Light/dark switch stored in bm_theme. Resolves an initial preference from local storage or the operating system and toggles the document's dark class in an effect. Browser access is deferred until effects for server compatibility.
frontend.src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx: Media-query hook using a 768px breakpoint. Initializes after mount, listens for viewport changes, and removes its listener during cleanup. Returns a boolean for responsive components.
frontend.src/hooks/use-pagination.ts: Client-side generic pagination of an already loaded array. Maintains zero-based page, computes total pages, slices pageItems, and resets when resetKey changes or the page falls out of range. It does not reduce the server dataset size.
frontend.src/hooks/use-reveal.ts: IntersectionObserver hook for entrance animation. Observes a DOM ref, reveals once, and has a 1.8 second visibility fallback. Cleans up the observer and timer to avoid lingering work after unmount.
frontend.src/lib/api.ts: Typed browser HTTP gateway. Defines token/user storage helpers, generic JSON request wrappers, multipart uploads, grouped school API operations, special backup blob/restore handling, and frontend interfaces. The operation catalog below expands nested methods. Generic types describe expected JSON but do not validate it at runtime.
frontend.src/lib/auth.tsx: Authentication context and role/permission helpers. Loads cached identity after mount; login stores token, user, permissions, and password-change flag; signOut clears local storage and user state. clearMustChangePassword persists the updated flag. hasAny checks role membership; hasPermission checks any matching required permission. signOut does not explicitly clear the QueryClient cache or revoke the server JWT.
frontend.src/lib/config.server.ts: Server-only configuration helper currently exposing nodeEnv. Reads process.env when called rather than at module initialization. The file contains guidance for server runtime environment bindings; the current build preset is node-server. Keep secrets out of public VITE variables.
frontend.src/lib/csv.ts: CSV download helper: converts cells to strings, doubles quotes, wraps cells in quotes, joins rows, creates a Blob URL, clicks a download link, and revokes the URL. It does not create XLSX or neutralize spreadsheet formula values.
frontend.src/lib/error-capture.ts: Short-lived diagnostic buffer for a recent global error or rejected promise. Records one value and time; consumeLastCapturedError clears it and ignores values older than five seconds. It is not a persistent error database.
frontend.src/lib/error-page.ts: Dependency-light HTML fallback for severe server rendering failures. Returns a complete page with embedded CSS and retry/home actions so it can render even when React startup fails.
frontend.src/lib/format.ts: money formats a possibly missing number using Intl.NumberFormat with ZMW as the default currency and a fallback string. shortId generates a short Math.random identifier for convenience, not a cryptographic identity or database uniqueness guarantee.
frontend.src/lib/grading.ts: Default integer grade bands and gradeFor lookup. It searches inclusive min/max bounds and falls back to the last band. Fractional values between integer bands can fall into gaps; compare with ParentPortalService threshold logic before teaching a grade policy.
frontend.src/lib/lovable-error-reporting.ts: Optional browser error-reporting bridge. Declares window.__lovableEvents typing and forwards an exception plus route/context if the bridge exists. Returns early on the server. A helper's presence does not prove every component calls it.
frontend.src/lib/utils.ts: cn composes clsx conditional class handling with tailwind-merge conflict resolution. UI wrappers use it to combine default classes with caller overrides without duplicate conflicting Tailwind utilities.
frontend.src/router.tsx: Constructs a QueryClient and TanStack Router with routeTree, query context, scroll restoration, and preload configuration. Global query error handling toasts 403 errors with a two-second deduplication window. Query retry declines 4xx retries and allows limited retries otherwise.
frontend.src/routeTree.gen.ts: Generated TanStack route registration and route types. Imports route modules, establishes parent relationships and paths, and exports routeTree. Update route source filenames/declarations and let the router tooling regenerate this file.
frontend.src/server.ts: TanStack Start server entry wrapper. Lazily imports the framework entry once, delegates fetch, detects a specific swallowed catastrophic JSON 500, logs a captured error, and returns the fallback HTML. This is frontend serving infrastructure, not the Spring business API.
frontend.src/start.ts: TanStack Start request middleware. Allows framework status-bearing errors to propagate and turns unexpected exceptions into the shared HTML 500 fallback. Registers middleware through startInstance.
frontend.src/styles.css: Application-wide Tailwind entry, colour and typography tokens, light/dark themes, reusable surfaces, responsive presentation, animations, and print rules. A CSS class shared by many routes can change many screens. Inspect @media print before altering print overlays or no-print classes.
frontend.src/routes/README.md: Local routing conventions and examples, including the root layout, dynamic parameter naming, pathless layouts, and generated route tree. Some examples are illustrative route names rather than existing school screens.
frontend.package.json: Frontend scripts, package metadata, and dependency ranges. Runtime libraries cover React, routing/query, UI primitives, styling, forms, charts, and validation. Dev dependencies provide Vite, TypeScript, ESLint, formatting, and server bundling. Package presence does not prove every library is used by every page.
frontend.vite.config.ts: Configures the Lovable/TanStack Vite wrapper, server entry, Nitro node-server output, an inline packaging dependency, and a development /api proxy to localhost:8081. The dev proxy is not a production reverse proxy.
frontend.tsconfig.json: TypeScript input files, modern JavaScript target, React JSX, bundler module resolution, strict checking, no emit, and @/* alias to src. Allows some unused declarations. Compiler settings do not validate server JSON.
frontend.eslint.config.js: Flat ESLint configuration for TypeScript, React hooks, React refresh, formatting integration, and a restricted import rule against the Next.js server-only package. Build directories are ignored. It checks source conventions, not business correctness.
frontend.components.json: UI generator metadata using the new-york style, TypeScript, CSS variables, Lucide icons, and project aliases. It guides generation of components; it is not the runtime router or backend configuration.
frontend.bunfig.toml: Bun installation policy including a 24-hour minimum release age and explicitly listed exceptions. This affects dependency installation, not school application behaviour.
frontend.examid.txt: Loose identifier scratch file at the project root. No application import/reference was established for it. Treat it as developer context rather than a route or database migration; its value is not needed in training examples.
frontend.supabase/config.toml: Supabase project configuration associated with the separate Supabase migration history. The active browser API client in this checkout calls Spring HTTP endpoints. This file does not configure Spring PostgreSQL connections.

backend.BrightMindsApplication.java: Spring Boot application entry. Enables scheduled jobs and starts component scanning from com.brightminds.school, making controllers, services, repositories, and configuration discoverable.
backend.CorsConfig.java: Binds app.cors properties and builds CORS policy with configured origins plus localhost/127.0.0.1 port patterns, supported HTTP verbs, headers, credentials, and preflight caching. SecurityConfig calls this policy. Localhost patterns are present in the current configuration regardless of a separate profile switch.
backend.DataInitializer.java: ApplicationRunner that creates an initial SUPER_ADMIN account only if the entire user table is empty. Hashes the configured bootstrap password with PasswordEncoder and saves the user/role relationship. It does not reset an existing administrator when configuration changes.
backend.JacksonConfig.java: Configures JSON serialization of Hibernate lazy proxies and blank-as-null LocalDate parsing. FORCE_LAZY_LOADING supports nested entity responses but can produce extra queries. Dates use ISO_LOCAL_DATE; arbitrary date formats are not accepted by this helper.
backend.OpenApiConfig.java: Declares API title/version and a Bearer Auth JWT scheme for generated OpenAPI documentation. Documentation security metadata does not replace the actual Spring Security filter and method checks.
backend.SecurityConfig.java: Enables web/method security, stateless bearer authentication, CORS, BCrypt, authentication manager/provider, selected anonymous paths, and JwtFilter ordering. Uses controller-relative paths because /api is the servlet context. Registration is still guarded in AuthController.
backend.CustomUserDetails.java: Adapts AppUser to Spring UserDetails. Exposes password hash and email and converts role strings to ROLE_ authorities. Account enabled/locked/expired methods currently return permissive constants; staff status is not automatically an account lock.
backend.CustomUserDetailsService.java: Loads a login identity by email, then phone fallback, within a read-only transaction. Builds CustomUserDetails from the found user. The token subject later uses the canonical email.
backend.JwtFilter.java: Once-per-request filter extracting Bearer tokens, reading the subject, reloading user details, checking validity, and placing Authentication into SecurityContextHolder. Token failures are caught and the request continues without authentication; access policy handles denial.
backend.JwtUtil.java: Creates HS256 JWTs with email subject, issue/expiry dates, and a Base64-decoded configured key. Parses signed claims and validates subject/expiry. A signed token is not encrypted; role permissions are resolved from current database identity rather than embedded permission claims here.
backend.AuthService.java: Registration hashes credentials and creates role links; login authenticates through AuthenticationManager and records a LOGIN audit entry. buildResponse generates the token and resolves role permissions for frontend UI gating. Registration access control is in AuthController.
backend.AuditService.java: Persists explicit audit records with action/entity/details and, when possible, current user ID from the security context. Has a short overload for simple calls. It is invoked by selected actions and is not an automatic database change capture mechanism.
backend.BackupService.java: Coordinates pg_dump/psql processes, ZIP database/upload packaging, disk snapshots, scheduled retention, and restore. JDBC parsing extracts host/port/database. Uses PGPASSWORD in the subprocess environment. Restore updates filesystem and SQL separately, so it is not an atomic database/files transaction. Process output is read before the timed wait, which can limit the effectiveness of the intended timeout for a hung process.
backend.ClassScopeService.java: Derives teacher record scope from role authorities and classes assigned through staff userId. null means unrestricted; an empty set means no allowed classes. Admin-tier roles bypass restriction. Other non-teacher roles are unrestricted by this service and still depend on permission rules.
backend.DashboardService.java: Read-only aggregate service counting active pupils/staff, classes, today's PRESENT records, confirmed collections from the start of the month, and recent announcement summaries. This data endpoint exists separately from the frontend's settings-driven welcome dashboard.
backend.FeeAutoBillingService.java: Creates recurring-class and transport invoices with ordinary duplicate checks on pupil plus fee item. Class fees copy term, amount, description, and due date. Transport picks point or route price, finds/creates a current-term fee item, and issues an invoice if not already billed. Checks are not by themselves concurrency locks.
backend.GlobalExceptionHandler.java: Central MVC exception-to-ApiError translator for validation, bad arguments, missing records, credentials, permissions, malformed JSON, integrity conflicts, explicit statuses, and generic errors. The generic 500 message includes exception text; security-filter failures may be outside this handler.
backend.GuardianAccountService.java: Saves guardian profiles and optionally creates or reuses a login. Resolves linked account ID first and email second, avoids another account's email, hashes temporary credentials, sets mustChangePassword, ensures PARENT role, and writes userId onto the guardian. Pupil linking remains a separate relationship.
backend.InvoiceBalanceService.java: Central balance mutation: add a signed delta, clamp paid at zero, derive UNPAID/PARTIAL/PAID against total, and save the invoice. Callers must supply the correct confirmed-payment delta and transaction context. It does not itself validate overpayment or lock concurrent writers.
backend.LencoService.java: External mobile-money collection integration. Validates network/phone/positive amount; initiates provider collection; stores a gateway attempt; checks provider status; converts success to a confirmed payment and credits the invoice. verifySignature checks raw-body HMAC SHA512 and extractReference accepts several reference keys. paymentId is an ordinary duplicate guard; there is no explicit transaction/locking spanning status save, payment save, and balance update.
backend.ParentPortalService.java: Current guardian resolution and linked-child authorization, attendance summaries, and term report-card DTO construction. Pivots four assessment types, averages available percentages and then subjects, chooses remarks, resolves historical class display from enrollment, and calculates rank. Ranking query still uses current pupil class; attendance counts PRESENT plus LATE over recorded entries. Grade thresholds differ in implementation from frontend integer-band lookup.
backend.PasswordResetService.java: Generates a secure random URL token, stores a one-hour expiry, emails a frontend reset link, validates/consumes tokens, and clears temporary-password requirements. Recovery returns the same observable response for missing accounts, although lookup/mail work is not literally identical in timing. Failed email delivery logs the link in the current code.
backend.PermissionService.java: Named perm Spring component used by @PreAuthorize expressions. Resolves current role names into dynamic role grants, with SUPER_ADMIN bypass. allPermissions builds the list returned at login. New database permissions matter only where relevant backend/UI code checks them.
backend.PromotionService.java: Transactional bulk pupil promotion. Deduplicates IDs, validates active pupils and next configured grade, checks destination capacity, closes active enrollment, updates current class, creates enrollment/promotion history, bills recurring fees, and logs the operation. history converts records into a compact DTO.
backend.PupilService.java: Pupil persistence and lifecycle rules. Generates/normalizes admission numbers, maps request fields, resolves class, manages enrollment on creation/class changes, and invokes recurring billing. Service write methods are transactional. Most optional null fields preserve values but an absent classId clears class association in the mapper.
backend.RateLimiterService.java: Single-process fixed-window request limiter using ConcurrentHashMap and a synchronized bucket. Counts attempts until a window expires, prunes old entries hourly, and resolves client address from forwarded headers or remote address. Not shared across clustered nodes or preserved across restart.
backend.StaffAccountService.java: Synchronizes staff details with login accounts, validates temporary-password provisioning, reuses account links/email, hashes credentials, and updates mustChangePassword. Adds TEACHER for teaching staff and removes that role for nonteachers while leaving other roles. Links staff.userId to the saved account.
backend.StaffService.java: Staff CRUD with generated staff number, request mapping, search, teacher lookup, and account synchronization. create/update delegate StaffAccountService. Some nullable fields preserve prior values while contractEndDate is explicitly replaced. Staff deletion is not automatically the same as deleting the linked AppUser.
backend.AcademicYearController.java: Academic year and term endpoints. Creates year/term entities, resolves the owning year for a term, handles current flags, and deletes records. Reads are authenticated through the global chain; management actions have academic_years:manage method rules.
backend.AccountsController.java: Expense list and creation plus correction/deletion actions. Maps category/amount/payment/date/reference fields, supports optional filters, and writes audit entries for correction. accounts:reverse method rules are distinct from ordinary accounts:manage access.
backend.AdmissionController.java: Application management and read-only admissions access. Stores registration fee details and applicant contacts; updates status; enroll creates a pupil through PupilService and links the application. Some update fields are assigned unconditionally, so a fee-only partial request can clear unrelated values. Enrollment guards ordinary repeats using the pupil link but is not one explicit controller transaction spanning all steps.
backend.AnnouncementController.java: Notice list/create/update/delete. List uses principal role information to choose relevant audiences; management uses announcements:post. Audience filtering is separate from whether a user may publish. Read the individual get endpoint when comparing list filtering with direct record access.
backend.AttendanceController.java: Date/class and date-range attendance queries, per-pupil history, single/bulk upsert, and update. Uses class scope for access and pupil/date for upsert identity. Requested class scope is not a full membership check for the independently requested pupil. Bulk create has no explicit outer transaction.
backend.AuditController.java: Paginated audit log endpoint under /admin/audit, protected by audit:view. Supports optional entity filtering and newest-first ordering. Returns a Spring Page shape; compare with frontend pagination expectations.
backend.AuthController.java: Login with per-IP-and-identifier rate limiting, SUPER_ADMIN registration, and authenticated own-password change. Uses validation on login/registration/password DTOs and PasswordEncoder on replacement. change-password clears the persisted mustChangePassword flag.
backend.BackupController.java: Protected selected-table JSON export, SQL dump, full ZIP, scheduled archive listing/download, and restore upload. Restore has its own permission and first saves a pre-restore snapshot. JSON is a selected-table export; full ZIP includes the database dump and files. Filename checks constrain scheduled archive downloads.
backend.CanteenController.java: Menu, meal plan, sale, and subscription endpoints with view/manage rules and selected pupil scope checks. Sale totals are calculated from unit price and quantity. Subscription cancellation sets status. These records do not inherently run the transport/class fee auto-billing service.
backend.ClassController.java: School class CRUD and my-classes lookup through the current user's linked staff profile. Maps class teacher, level order, stream, and capacity. classes:view protects class reads; management methods use classes:manage.
backend.CommunicationController.java: Lists and saves message records with content, channel, audience, class and recipient label. The send method timestamps and persists a Message but does not invoke an external delivery provider. This distinction matters when interpreting sentAt and the frontend confirmation.
backend.DashboardController.java: Thin authenticated dashboard endpoint delegating aggregate construction to DashboardService. Its existence does not imply every frontend dashboard component consumes that endpoint.
backend.DisciplineController.java: Pupil discipline/reward list, create and delete. Reads pupil association, records kind/date/details, and filters/checks teacher class scope. Uses separate view/manage permission expressions.
backend.DocumentController.java: School document metadata CRUD with documents:view/manage checks. Stores a title/category/description and URL; actual file upload/serving is in FileUploadController. Deleting this row does not implement physical file deletion.
backend.EventController.java: Authenticated calendar reads with events:manage writes. Maps event title, description, start/end timestamps, location and audience. Case-insensitive enum deserialization is configured globally for lower-case UI values.
backend.ExamController.java: Exam definitions and mark upserts. Resolves term for creation and pupil/subject for marks. Mark identity is pupil/exam/subject and class scope is checked. update changes name/date/outOf/weight but currently ignores termId/assessmentType. Mark score bounds are not explicitly validated in addMark.
backend.FeeController.java: Fee item configuration, invoice creation/filtering/reversal, payment collection/correction/confirmation/rejection, online gateway actions and daily late fees. Central invoice balance service is called for confirmed changes. Late fee is 35 and creates a separate invoice; unpaid late-fee invoices are not explicitly excluded from future sweeps. Several multi-save operations lack an explicit enclosing transaction.
backend.FileUploadController.java: Multipart upload allowlist, UUID filename generation, local disk write, returned URL, and public file serving with path containment checks. Serve responses are public/immutable cached. Checks declared MIME type, not a full content inspection. The returned URL is hardcoded under /api/uploads even though an uploads public-base-url setting exists.
backend.GuardianController.java: Guardian management plus PARENT-only current-user/child finance and attendance endpoints. Uses ParentPortalService for ownership and report data. Parent claims are PENDING; online collections create gateway attempts. Explicitly checks invoice child ownership. Contact/account provisioning and guardian-pupil linking are separate actions.
backend.HealthController.java: Clinic records for pupils with create/update/delete and health permission checks. Resolves pupil relationship and applies class scope where implemented. Fields represent recorded visits, symptoms/treatment/outcome, not an automatic diagnosis engine.
backend.HomeworkController.java: Homework CRUD with class/subject/attachment associations. Lists can filter by class; teacher scope constrains class-related access. The row contains a file URL rather than the attachment bytes.
backend.InquiryController.java: Staff-facing website inquiry inbox, protected independently from public submission. Lists newest first, marks a row read, and deletes. Separate public and staff controller surfaces avoid mixing anonymous submit with administrative actions.
backend.InventoryController.java: Inventory catalog and transaction endpoints. IN and ADJUST add quantity, OUT subtracts with a zero floor. Item updates and transaction inserts are separate repository writes without an explicit controller transaction. Low-stock lookup delegates the repository query.
backend.LeaveController.java: Staff leave requests with optional filters and approval/rejection actions. Maps staff/date/type/reason into a row and changes status. Global leave:manage access is not the same as a general self-service employee portal.
backend.LencoWebhookController.java: Anonymous provider callback endpoint that verifies raw-body signature, extracts a reference, and rechecks authoritative provider status through LencoService. Invalid/missing signatures are logged and ignored with a normal return. Provider delivery setup remains external to this controller.
backend.LibraryController.java: Catalog CRUD, optional book search, loan creation and return. Borrowing decrements available copies; returns increment them. Repeated returns have no returned-status guard. Search returns a paginated result while unfiltered books returns a List. Multi-save circulation operations are not explicitly transactional here.
backend.PayrollController.java: Payroll periods, approve/mark-paid actions, and payslip CRUD. Computes net as basic plus allowances minus deductions minus tax. Mark-paid sums slips into a Salaries expense and rejects an already paid period. Corrections need payroll:reverse; correcting a slip does not automatically reconcile an existing paid-period expense.
backend.ProcurementController.java: Supplier CRUD and purchase order lifecycle. Computes line totals during transactional creation. Transactional receive rejects cancelled/repeated receipt, increments item quantities, records IN transactions, and stamps receivedAt. Plain status editing cannot perform RECEIVED because stock effects must accompany it.
backend.PromotionController.java: Permission-protected promotion action and history endpoint. Delegates the multi-record transaction and validation to PromotionService and supplies the authenticated principal for the audit/history record.
backend.PtcController.java: PTC sessions and meetings with separate current teacher/current guardian list endpoints. Administrative creation/update/delete requires ptc:manage. Meeting update patches selected note/status/date fields. Teacher note UI still needs the permission required by this shared update method.
backend.PublicController.java: Minimal public branding and landing DTOs, inquiry submission, inquiry mail notifications, and password recovery/reset. Does not expose the whole settings entity as public content. Recovery is rate limited; real email depends on runtime SMTP configuration.
backend.PupilController.java: Pupil REST boundary delegating lifecycle logic to PupilService and enforcing action permissions/class scope. Paginated teacher results are currently filtered after fetching a global page and report filtered size/one total page; this is not equivalent to paging the complete authorized set.
backend.ReportCardController.java: Term-scoped teacher/head remarks keyed by pupil and term. Uses report_cards:view at class level for both read and save and checks pupil scope. Restricted teachers can save class-teacher remarks while head-teacher remark assignment is skipped.
backend.ReportController.java: School summary aggregation protected by reports:view. Counts pupils/staff/classes, confirmed financial measures, expenses, library and operational totals into a ReportSummary response. Distinguish this aggregate from page-specific client calculations.
backend.RoleController.java: Dynamic roles and permission registry CRUD. Normalizes custom role names, protects system role edit/delete, replaces permission associations from IDs, and audits selected changes. A module-wide frontend toggle may send many permission IDs. Method-level role grants are consulted by PermissionService.
backend.SettingsController.java: Singleton school settings read/update plus separate SUPER_ADMIN dashboard and landing update actions. Stores images, contact/identity fields, and JSON strings for content lists. Settings returned to authenticated users are broader than public branding DTOs.
backend.StaffController.java: Staff REST boundary, searches/all/teachers/detail/me endpoints, CRUD and account provisioning. Delegates lifecycle to StaffService and StaffAccountService. staff:view is the class-level read rule; staff:manage protects writes.
backend.SubjectController.java: Subject list/detail/create/update/delete with view-or-manage reads and manage writes. A simple controller-to-repository example. Codes and names map into Subject and can be referenced by marks, timetables and homework.
backend.TimetableController.java: Class slot list/create/delete with teacher scope and timetable:manage writes. Resolves class/subject/teacher IDs. It stores weekday/time/room; a complete overlap/conflict validation system is not implemented by the existence of these fields.
backend.TransportController.java: Vehicles, transport routes, priced pickup points and pupil assignments. Assign saves a relation then invokes transport billing. It independently resolves route and pickup point without explicitly checking that the chosen point belongs to the chosen route. Deleting an assignment does not reverse its invoice.
backend.UniformController.java: Uniform module reusing fee_items category UNIFORM and invoices. Catalog edits price/name and sale creates an invoice from price times positive/default quantity. Scope checks the pupil. The selected fee item is found by ID without an explicit category assertion in sell/update/delete; inventory stock is not involved.
backend.UserManagementController.java: Administrative users API returning a curated UserDto. Creates hashed temporary credentials, validates role names against the role registry, replaces role links, resets passwords, and deletes accounts. UserDto avoids returning AppUser directly. User/role/password updates produce selected audit records.
backend.pom.xml: Maven project model for Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.5.3 with web, JPA, security, validation, mail, PostgreSQL, Flyway, Hibernate JSON support, Lombok, JWT, OpenAPI and testing libraries. Compiler source encoding is UTF-8. Spring Boot plugin packages the runnable application.
backend.application.yml: Runtime property tree for datasource, JPA, Flyway, JSON, multipart uploads, SMTP, HTTP port/context path, JWT, frontend links, bootstrap admin, backup tools/retention, gateway credentials, upload paths, CORS and logging. Environment placeholders override defaults. The datasource comment and its fallback port disagree; inspect DB_URL in the running process. Secret defaults are redacted in the training source listing.
backend.PupilServiceTest.java: Mockito unit test for generating an admission number when blank. Mocks repositories and checks the PUP-year-random pattern and request mutation. Does not exercise a real database, permissions or class billing; no class is assigned in its scenario.
backend.StaffServiceTest.java: Mockito test intended to check generated staff number. The current StaffService also calls StaffAccountService.sync, but the test does not provide that mock/stub. It can fail with a null dependency before asserting. This is a code-reading finding, not a test execution result.
